cues: On the floor, flow from the 90/90 sit through the butterfly sit to the deep squat.
Sit tall with the soles together and let the knees sink toward the floor.
Breathe out as you sink into each position; move on the breath in.

faults.fix: Slow down: one full breath out in every position before you move on.

faults.fault: Forcing the end of the range
faults.fix: Stop where the position stays smooth; the range grows over the weeks.

name: Controlled Hip Circle, Standing
setup: Stand tall, or take the position named, everything else still.
cues: Hold the wall and draw the biggest slow circle you can with the knee, the standing side still.
Draw the biggest slow circle you can, smooth all the way round.
Everything that is not circling stays still.

faults.fault: The whole body swinging with the circle
faults.fix: Slow it down until only the one joint draws the circle.

name: Walking Spiderman with Overhead Reach
setup: Open floor, about 15 metres.
cues: Step into a spiderman lunge, reach the inside hand up toward the ceiling, then step through.
Smooth and steady down the floor, a little bigger each rep.
Tall between reps, like a string pulling up to the ceiling.

faults.fix: Slow and smooth: each rep a little bigger than the one before.
